summary: Retain combined-left-section-handles-v6 (61a07eaa-8371-4a72-81cf-c46239175a45) as an unqualified left-shoulder diagnostic only. Whole proximal-arm cross-section translation (0.01805H) plus coherent chest compression (0.00349H at 60 degrees, 0 at 90 degrees) within the frozen 0.02H shoulder cap eliminates the flat vertical inner-arm notch produced by sheet-side handles v5 (f89461c3) and reduces measured left-shoulder self-intersections from 348 to 0 (60 degrees straight), 93 to 0 (90 degrees straight), 363 to 0 (60/elbow60/twist-20), 364 to 16 (60/elbow60/twist0), 396 to 63 (60/elbow60/twist+20), and 107 to 0 (90/elbow90/twist0) with zero contact regressions across all 25 poses and zero severely stretched edges. However, Babylon visual review still finds a compressed anterior axillary crease at 60 degrees and a horizontal deltoid-biceps transition dent/undulation where the axial section envelope ([0, 0.25, 0.7, 1.0]) fades out at 60 and 90 degrees, while right shoulder (390/166 straight, 443/414/386/178 compound) and left-hip compound twist (42 at 90/knee90/twist+20; 17 at twist+10) remain at baseline.

companion_normal_transport.summary: Pre-skin morph normal delta transport reduces active support normal divergence on training poses from max 58.53 deg to 5.73e-6 deg (UpperArmL 60, 1359 vertices) and max 64.01 deg to 1.88e-6 deg (UpperArmL 90, 957 vertices) with 0 support vertices worse over 1 deg, and reduces >30 deg normal errors on compound left-shoulder poses (67->0, 71->2, 79->6, 134->28) while passing gltf-validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10 with 0 errors.

limitations: Fifteen contour captures and six normal-corrected captures inspected directly, not all 175+15 captures.
Front camera at UpperArmL 90 degrees looks down the forward-raised forearm and partially occludes the anterior shoulder root; oblique and side views expose the deltoid-biceps transition.
Left shoulder still exhibits a compressed anterior axillary crease at 60 degrees and a horizontal transition dent/undulation where the axial section handle envelope ([0, 0.25, 0.7, 1.0]) terminates.
Right shoulder (UpperArmR) and left-hip twist (ThighL 90/knee90/twist+20 and +10) were held at baseline as controls in this isolated left-shoulder trial.
Khronos gltf-validator reports 0 errors and 1 NODE_SKINNED_MESH_NON_ROOT warning on contour-diagnostic.glb (plus 2 BUFFER_VIEW_TARGET_MISSING hints and 2 UNUSED_OBJECT infos on normal-corrected.glb).
No game clips, outfit fitting, production 8-influence admission, or avatar publication is claimed.
